Awful service
May 2022 • Solo
I visited twice. 1st night was ok although service very slow. 2nd time was around 8.30pm. Again service slow.. after 20 min waiting I walked down the stairs to see if someone could take my order. I was then told only 3 dishes were available. I picked beef stew with crusty bread. When it arrived bread was stale & hard. The stew was basically water with a few bits of gristle & no meat & cold. Raised this to manager & was told this is how Vietnamese eat it.:. Not actual meat. I said it wasn’t acceptable & I was just looked at. I said I would pay for my drink. I was told I had to pay for food even tho it hadn’t been touched. When I refused I was told the police would be called!! Very intimidating behaviour as a young solo female traveller. In the end I just paid & left

Pleasant restaurant and good food
Feb 2020
We visited Rue Du Camp cafe/bistro early on a Saturday evening. We went up to the 1st level seating area. Waitress was attentive and friendly. We ordered a battered prawn appetiser followed by Szechuan beef and Teriyaki beef. Both were nicely presented on a large platter with smaller dishes - one vegetable broth, one salad and the main plate with rice and beef. The broth was very lightly flavoured and not very hot (in keeping with all establishments we've used in Hanoi - lukewarm broth seems to be the way of things here!). The salad was fresh and tasty, the beef and rice were delicious. We had a beer and a Rosebud tea. The tea was presented in a glass teapot on a glass burner/tealight stand. The rose buds slowly infused and opened to release their flavour. It was lovely. 

All in all we spent VND560,000/GBP20/USD24 + tip as no service charge was included. Excellent value for money.
